summary: Sample ServiceAccount, Role (pods, pods/log, pods/attach, secrets) and RoleBinding for container groups; apply with oc apply -f containergroup-sa.yml, get a token with oc create token --duration, and extract the CA from the wildcard-tls secret.
questions: What RBAC does a container group service account need?
How do I generate a token for the container group service account?
How do I get the OpenShift CA certificate for a container group credential?
Example service account YAML for AAP container groups

answer_card.title: Service account for a container group
answer_card.answer_md:
Apply the ServiceAccount, Role (verbs on `pods`, `get` on `pods/log`, `create` on `pods/attach`, `get/create/delete` on `secrets`) and RoleBinding:

```
oc apply -f containergroup-sa.yml
oc create token containergroup-service-account --duration=$((365*24))h > containergroup-sa.token
oc get secret -n openshift-ingress wildcard-tls -o jsonpath='{.data.ca\.crt}' | base64 -d > containergroup-ca.crt
```

Use the token and CA in an OpenShift or Kubernetes API Bearer Token credential.
